args.text:
Fixed-limit hold'em, 4 players. Play tight-aggressive.
Preflop: raise strong hands (pairs 9+, AK, AQ, AJs, KQs). Fold weak offsuit junk, esp. out of early position. Limp/call only with suited connectors or small pairs in late position with cheap action.
Postflop: bet/raise with top pair or better and strong draws; check-call medium hands; fold to heavy multi-way aggression without a made hand. Avoid bluffing into multiple opponents.
Do not chase weak draws for big sums. Value-bet strong hands for max; in fixed limit, raise when likely ahead.
Watch opponents: note who bluffs, who folds to pressure, who calls too much. Adjust: bluff more vs tight folders, value-bet thinner vs calling stations.

Fixed-limit hold'em, 4 players. Tight-aggressive, disciplined.
- Preflop: raise/3-bet premium (TT+, AK, AQ, KQs, AJs+). Play medium pairs, suited aces, suited connectors and broadway from late position or cheaply. Fold junk (J6o, 25o, 72o) even in blinds, especially facing raises.

- Flop/turn: bet ace-high or better when checked to heads-up/few players; check back weak showdown hands (pair of tens with ace kicker is fine to check down).
- Pot odds: call when pot odds beat roughly 5:1 with a real hand; river bets after checks from weak players often mean something, so call with decent pairs.
- Value bet strong made hands (sets, two pair+) and raise full houses.
- Opponents: A01 raises and calls wide, check-calls then sometimes bets river (can be bluff/value). A02 and A04 call a lot. A04 raised 4 from the cutoff/button. Bluffs are less profitable against these loose-calling players; prefer value.
